sections.attorneyText1: Every case team includes licensed attorneys who review critical documents and make sure local rules and ethical requirements are followed.
sections.attorneyText2: Your information is encrypted and handled only by team members who have signed NDAs.

faqAccident.a: Yes. The case review costs nothing. If we take your case, we are paid only if you win, as a percentage of the recovery.

faqAccident.q: What happens after I submit my case?
faqAccident.a: A real attorney or case manager reviews it and calls you within 24 hours. There is no pressure, and you decide what to do next.

faqAccident.q: What types of accidents do you help with?
faqAccident.a: Car, truck and transport, motorcycle, rideshare, pedestrian, wrongful death, slip and fall, and dog bite cases.
Only our team. It is encrypted, never sold, and never shared with third parties without your permission.

faqAccident.q: What if I already talked to the insurance company?
faqAccident.a: That is okay. Do not sign anything or give a recorded statement until you have spoken with us.

faqBusiness.a: Yes. Transport companies, fleets and other businesses can register at no cost. When your business has a case in the future, we handle it free.
Trucking carriers, freight brokers, logistics companies, towing, school and passenger buses, rideshare and delivery fleets, medical transport and other businesses with vehicles or drivers.

faqBusiness.q: Can a small business with only a few vehicles register?
faqBusiness.a: Yes. The registration form has fleet sizes from 1 to 5 vehicles up to 100 or more, so businesses of any size can register.
A real person reviews your registration and calls you within 24 hours to get to know your business.
